task_metadata.research_topic: self-distillation objective design for flow-map generative models
task_metadata.research_question: How should the diagonal and self-distillation loss terms for flow maps be designed to improve CIFAR-10 generation quality under a fixed training budget?
notes: The task description identifies flow-maps as a NeurIPS 2025 project; the literature entries below are grounded in citation API results, which currently resolve the core paper via its arXiv DOI.

tests.label: bench-lsd
tests.notes: Benchmarks the Lagrangian Self-Distillation loss family on CIFAR-10 using FID.

tests.label: bench-psd-uniform
tests.notes: Benchmarks Progressive Self-Distillation with uniform teacher mixing on CIFAR-10 using FID.

tests.label: bench-psd-midpoint
tests.notes: Benchmarks Progressive Self-Distillation with midpoint teacher mixing on CIFAR-10 using FID.

tests.label: bench-esd
tests.notes: Benchmarks Eulerian Self-Distillation on CIFAR-10 using FID.

baselines.name: paper
baselines.notes: Restores the official flow-maps loss terms from Boffi et al.

papers.title: How to build a consistency model: Learning flow maps via self-distillation
papers.relevance: This is the core flow-maps paper for the task and explicitly introduces the Eulerian, Lagrangian, and Progressive self-distillation families benchmarked by the scripts.

papers.title: Flow map matching with stochastic interpolants: A mathematical framework for consistency models
papers.relevance: Provides the mathematical framework underlying flow-map learning and directly positions flow maps as a unifying view over consistency and progressive distillation methods.

papers.title: Stochastic Interpolants: A Unifying Framework for Flows and Diffusions
papers.relevance: Flow-map matching in this task builds on stochastic interpolants, so this paper is part of the immediate theoretical lineage for the editable loss terms.

papers.title: Consistency Models
papers.relevance: Introduces the broader consistency-model perspective that flow maps generalize, making it directly relevant background for the task's self-distillation objective design.

papers.title: Improved Techniques for Training Consistency Models
papers.relevance: Discusses concrete objective and training refinements for consistency-style models, which is closely aligned with this task's goal of redesigning self-distillation losses under a fixed budget.

papers.title: Consistency Trajectory Models: Learning Probability Flow ODE Trajectory of Diffusion
papers.relevance: An important neighboring approach in the same few-step consistency/flow-map design space, explicitly discussed as part of the unification in the flow-map matching paper.

papers.title: Flow Matching for Generative Modeling
papers.relevance: Provides a major training paradigm for continuous-time generative flows and serves as direct background for flow-map objectives built around learned solution operators.

papers.title: Progressive Distillation for Fast Sampling of Diffusion Models
papers.relevance: Directly relevant antecedent for the task's Progressive Self-Distillation family and for the broader objective of reducing sampling cost with distilled multi-time dynamics.

papers.title: Rectified Flow: A Marginal Preserving Approach to Optimal Transport
papers.relevance: Rectified-flow objectives are part of the modern continuous-time generative modeling landscape that informs flow-map training and alternative transport-based loss constructions.

papers.title: Score-Based Generative Modeling through Stochastic Differential Equations
papers.relevance: Relevant foundational work for diffusion/flow generative modeling that motivates the continuous-time dynamics and sample-quality regime this task operates in.

papers.title: Elucidating the Design Space of Diffusion-Based Generative Models
papers.relevance: Useful related work on objective and preconditioning design in high-performing diffusion models, which is relevant when redesigning the loss geometry of flow-map training.

papers.title: Learning Multiple Layers of Features from Tiny Images
papers.relevance: This is the citation record surfaced by the citation API for CIFAR-10, the dataset used by every benchmark script in this task.

papers.title: GANs Trained by a Two Time-Scale Update Rule Converge to a Local Nash Equilibrium
papers.relevance: Introduces the Fréchet Inception Distance used as the task's primary evaluation metric across all four benchmark scripts.
